verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents a ZeroTrace Mode that, when enabled, stops storing search parameters, files, or data, so searches leave no retained record. This is a first-party privacy opt-out from per-search data retention. It is not described as a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, and only appears as a single pricing-page mention. Missing for 10: explicit telemetry/analytics opt-out for SDKs or the MCP server, documentation of how to enable ZeroTrace and which plans include it, clarity on what usage metadata is still tracked, and independent corroboration.
